caption: The drawing depicts a bouquet of flowers arranged in a decorative vase. The bouquet includes flowers with petals of blue, red, and orange, along with smaller red and blue buds. Each flower is attached to a green stem with green leaves of various shapes and sizes. The vase is cream-colored with a scalloped central section and decorated with blue dots, red lines, and red and green heart-shaped motifs. The entire composition is centered within a thin, double-lined rectangular border on an off-white background.
title: Quilt (One Square)
